objectives_fil: Maipaliwanag at mailapat sa isang sitwasyon: breastfeeding at kapaligiran.
objectives_en: Explain and apply in a situation: breastfeeding and the environment.

sections.takeaway_fil: Dalawang paksa: magalang na suporta sa breastfeeding at ligtas na pagbabawas ng hindi kailangang basura.
sections.takeaway_en: Two topics: respectful breastfeeding support and safe reduction of unnecessary waste.

sections.takeaway_fil: Institusyon ang responsable sa pasilidad; BHW ang nagtatanong, umaalalay at nag-uulat ng kakulangan.
sections.takeaway_en: The institution is responsible for facilities; the BHW checks, supports and reports gaps.

sections.takeaway_fil: Makinig nang magalang, pangalagaan ang privacy, at iugnay sa nakumpirmang sinanay na suporta.
sections.takeaway_en: Listen respectfully, protect privacy, and connect to confirmed trained support.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tiyakin ang saklaw at kasalukuyang direktiba; hindi blanket ban sa lahat ng plastic ang aralin.
sections.takeaway_en: Check the scope and current directive; this lesson does not treat every plastic item as banned.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang non-clinical na alternatibo; protektahan ang kinakailangang ligtas na clinical supplies.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm the non-clinical alternative; protect supplies needed for safe clinical care.

sections.takeaway_fil: Magalang na suporta at ligtas na pagbabawas ng basura: makinig, kumpirmahin, saka umalalay.
sections.takeaway_en: Respectful support and safe waste reduction: listen, confirm, then help.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang pinakamainam na susunod na hakbang ni Mimi?
check.prompt_en: What is Mimi’s best next step?

options.fil: Makinig nang pribado at may paggalang; kumpirmahin ang sinanay na suporta at lugar, at itanong sa supervisor ang reusable na lalagyan sa break area habang pinoprotektahan ang clinical supplies.
options.en: Listen privately and respectfully; confirm trained support and the space, and ask the supervisor about reusable containers in the break area while protecting clinical supplies.

options.fil: Ipangako agad na may kumpletong lactation station at palaging available na tagasuporta, kahit hindi pa ito nakumpirma.
options.en: Promise a fully equipped lactation station and an always-available support worker before confirming them.

options.fil: Pilitin ang feeding choice ng magulang para masabing nasunod ang polisiya, saka palitan nang kusa ang sterile na gamit ng reusable na kagamitan.
options.en: Impose a feeding choice to show policy compliance, then independently replace sterile supplies with reusable items.

check.feedback_fil: Ang unang sagot ay umaalalay nang may paggalang at kumpirmasyon: hindi pinipilit ang magulang, at hindi nangangako ng hindi pa tiyak na pasilidad o contact. Supervisor ang magpapatibay sa non-clinical na alternatibo. Hindi dahilan ang pagbabawas ng basura para alisin o i-reuse nang kusa ang sterile o kinakailangang clinical supplies.
check.feedback_en: The first response supports the parent with respect and confirmation: it imposes no choice and promises no unverified facility or contact. The supervisor confirms the non-clinical alternative. Reducing waste is not a reason to independently remove or reuse sterile or necessary clinical supplies.

sources.title: DOH BHW Reference Manual (2022), printed p. 6 / PDF p. 14 — breastfeeding facilities and unnecessary plastic
Republic Act No. 10028, sections 3, 4, 6 and 8 — lactation stations, institutional duties, exemptions and training

DOH BHW Facilitator Manual (2022), printed p. 15 / PDF p. 22 — workplace-policy training scope
